text: China reports a $1.19 trillion annual trade surplus as exports and imports both exceed expectations, while shipments to and from the United States decline sharply. Export growth is redirected toward non-U.S. partners amid flat domestic consumption and deflationary conditions.

meta.note: Aggregate surplus expansion coincides with bilateral contraction, creating directional ambiguity within the same reporting frame.

text: Bank of American reports quarterly earnings above estimates driven by higher net interest income and equities trading revenue, while fixed income trading lags forecasts and investment banking fees remain flat. Loan-loss provisions come in below expectations as revenue mix concentrates in rate- and market-linked segments.

meta.note: Share price decline alongside earnings beat introduces separation between operating results and market response.
